site.name: Gale Crater — Mount Sharp boxwork (sulfate-bearing unit)
site.boundsNote: 2 x 2 km centred on Curiosity's 2025-26 boxwork campaign (MMGIS traverse, sols ~4560-4841, centre -4.8051, 137.3814). Approved 2026-11-14 (CLAUDE.md §8 step 2); see docs/resources.md.

layers.name: HiRISE orthomosaic (Curiosity roving site)
layers.attribution: MRO HiRISE: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona, via NASA Mars Trek

layers.name: Hillshade
layers.attribution: Hillshade of the USGS MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m (HiRISE/CTX/HRSC, Parker & Calef 2016), 2 m cells

layers.name: Night warmth (THEMIS): warm = rock, cool = sand or dust
layers.attribution: Mars Odyssey THEMIS night-time infrared, controlled mosaic 100 m (NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University), via NASA Mars Trek. Relative brightness within the site.

layers.name: Minerals from orbit (CRISM): blue = water-bearing, green = olivine sand
layers.attribution: MRO CRISM observation FRT0000B6F1, summary parameters BD1900R2 and OLINDEX3 (NASA/JPL-Caltech/JHUAPL), PDS Geosciences Node. Smoothed to ~90 m; relative within the site, not abundances.
